title: Corn, canned, reduced sodium, cooked, fat added

content.title: About
content.content: Corn, canned, reduced sodium, cooked, fat added is a processed whole‑kernel corn packed in sealed cans. During production part of the sodium is replaced with lower‑salt alternatives, and plant fats are added to improve flavor and texture. The product is ready to eat without further cooking.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Canned corn retains most of its B‑vitamins and carotenoids.
Reduced sodium makes it a better choice for people monitoring salt intake.
Added plant fats increase caloric value and enhance mouthfeel.
Corn is one of the most widely canned vegetables in the United States and Europe.
Cans often use BPA‑free linings to ensure food safety.

items.title: Source of fiber
items.content: Corn provides dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Lutein and zeaxanthin help protect the eyes from age‑related changes.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: Reduced salt contributes to maintaining normal blood pressure.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Added plant fats raise the amount of healthy unsaturated fats, beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Contains vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports immune function and aids iron absorption.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to corn.

items.title: Fat content
items.content: The added fats increase calorie density, so portion control is important for weight‑managed diets.

items.title: Bisphenol A (BPA)
items.content: While many manufacturers now use BPA‑free cans, check labeling if you are sensitive to this compound.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some varieties may contain a small amount of added sugar for flavor balance.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Eat the corn straight from the can, add it to salads, soups, pasta, omelets, or use it as a filling for tacos and burritos. It can also be briefly warmed in the microwave or on a skillet if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened cans in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the corn in a sealed container in the refrigerator and consume within 3‑4 days. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
